## Description

Computes the Wasserstein barycenter across multiple competing economic scenario return distributions to construct an optimal consensus portfolio robust to model divergence.

## Where it may fit

High macroeconomic uncertainty, conflicting macro forecast scenarios, regime shift transitions.

## Vehicles

Multi-Asset Allocators, Pension Funds, Wealth Management Platforms.

## Required data

Multiple predictive return distribution forecasts from macro models or stress testing engines.

## Caveats

Wasserstein distance computations scale quadratically with sample size; regularization via Sinkhorn algorithm recommended.
